page.overview:
What is Minor Animatronics?

This is a list of minor animatronics from the Five Nights at Freddy's novel series, The Silver Eyes, The Twisted Ones and The Fourth Closet. They have a very small role in the series and all their names are undisclosed.

After Charlie's mother left, Henry began building a mechanical toy for her. It was a little dog toy who tilted its head side to side. Once it was finished, it made Charlie happy.

William Afton traps a kidnapped Carlton Burke inside a heavy, barrel-shaped torso of a spring lock suit with wide shoulders. The mascot costume is only a torso and arms that hang limp and empty from the sides. Its head has been removed and set a few feet away on a cardboard box. The costume's fur is dirty and matted, and its presumably bright blue color has faded into a bluish color similar to beige. On the back of the costume is a series of ten leather and metal fasteners. Its species is vague and isn't easily identified.

Graphic Novel #1: The Silver Eyes depicts this animatronic to be slightly based on a beaver. Its head has buck teeth, shorter ears, rosy turquoise cheeks, and darker blue eyebrows. The costume has a large, sky-blue, barrel-esque torso equipped two small buttons on a cyan heart-shaped underbelly. Unlike most spring lock suits, it only has four fingers instead of the usual five.
